description: This PHP file implements the DetailView for the 'Groups' module in the SuiteCRM application. It handles rendering the group's detail page, retrieving the group data from the database, and outputting the HTML template with the group's information.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: A class responsible for processing and rendering detail views of CRM entities.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes and fetches the specified SugarBean object for display in the detail view.
